title: The Sword in the Stone
tagline: Pull the sword. Then do the dishes.
about: A young boy called Wart is tutored by the wizard Merlin and pulls the sword from the stone.
cue: Serve the mains when Merlin magics the castle dishes into washing themselves.
faces: Crusty bread chunks with aged cheddar, pickled onions and green apple.
